text: Direct evidence for why this bead matters: bd-01KZXQAW39E8XCXJJVW7C7M2M6 is a hard p0 failure at p=50000 that the existing 50k scale test does NOT catch, because that test exercises .euclidean_support_index directly and never constructs a frame signature. A scale gate that is both skipped by default AND does not cover the full plan path gave no warning at all.
